game_meta.title: Far Cry New Dawn
game_meta.setting: Hope County, Montana (Post-Apocalyptic / 17 Years After FC5)

sources.title: Far Cry Fandom Wiki - Far Cry New Dawn

treasure_hunts.name: For Whom the Bear Tolls
treasure_hunts.summary: Shoot the church bell to draw in an infected bear, defeat it to claim Fowler's Crypt Key, and descend into the catacomb bunker.
solution_steps: Head to the church roof at the FANG Center.
Shoot the bell inside the belfry to lure the hostile bear.
Eliminate the bear and loot its body for Fowler's Crypt Key.
Locate the ground opening southwest of the church to enter the crypt.

treasure_hunts.name: Going Haywire
treasure_hunts.summary: Navigate an electrified compound by shooting off the building lock from the roof and deactivating the terminal inside.
solution_steps: Climb onto the roof of the main structure.
Shoot the interior door latch through the opening in the roof.
Enter through the unlocked door and clear the inner room.
Flip the breaker switch to kill the live electrical current blocking the bunker hatch.

treasure_hunts.name: High Art
treasure_hunts.summary: Use the grapple and zipline to breach a high-level art studio barn, adjusting car-hoist hydraulic valves to unblock the bunker.
solution_steps: Grapple to the water tower outside and zipline through the upper barn window.
Crouch through the storage loft and drop down to the main floor.
Turn the first hydraulic valve underneath the upper catwalk to elevate the first vehicle.
Climb back up, leap across the elevated vehicle, and turn the second valve to clear the bunker door.

treasure_hunts.name: Riddle Me Fish
treasure_hunts.summary: Observe the singing fish wall mountings in the generator cabin to decipher the order, then match it in the gas-filled basement.
solution_steps: Break the wooden barriers to enter the upper cabin and activate the electrical generator.
Observe the exact sequence of moving fish trophies (Standard: Green, Orange, Purple, Black, Blue, Yellow / 2-4-6-1-3-5).
Drop through the shed hatch into the underground chamber.
Trigger the fish trophies in the matching sequence before poisonous gas causes lethal burn damage.

treasure_hunts.name: Target Practice
treasure_hunts.summary: Drop into an underground shooting range and trigger targets in sequence to feed mechanical counterweights that open the security gate.
solution_steps: Locate the barricaded hole in the junkyard and drop to the lower level.
Pull the primary gear release lever to start the track machinery.
Shoot all kinetic targets as they slide across both left and right tracks.
Ensure both bucket counterweights drop to release the reinforced vault gate.

treasure_hunts.name: Rescuers Go Under
treasure_hunts.summary: Ascend the rockfaces of Misery Falls using the grapple tool, then dive and traverse submerged cavern systems to reach a forgotten survivor cache.
solution_steps: Locate the climb trail starting at the base of the falls using grappling anchor points.
Dive into the mountain sinkhole pool and swim underwater through the flooded tunnel.
Grapple swing across the high cavern stalactites to reach the survivor ledge.
Release the handbrake on the stranded vehicle or climb the ledge to access the cache.

treasure_hunts.name: Light 'Em Up
treasure_hunts.summary: Infestations of wolverines have nested inside the church. Burn out the nests to reveal the stash key.
solution_steps: Enter the boarded chapel through the damaged perimeter.
Locate the wolverine nest high on the church rafters.
Use fire (Molotov, incendiary ammo, or torch) to destroy the nest.
Eliminate the agitated wolverine, retrieve the Highwaymen Shed Key, and unlock the yard bunker.

treasure_hunts.name: Burning Souls
treasure_hunts.summary: Gather the scattered remains of fallen Edenites onto a ritual pyre and ignite it to release the sealed cavern vault.
solution_steps: Locate the unlit central bonfire pit before the barricaded cave entrance.
Scour the abandoned settlement to locate all 5 bodies.
Carry and drop each body into the central bonfire pyre.
Ignite the pyre using a torch, Molotov, or flaming arrow to trigger the vault door.

treasure_hunts.name: Go With the Flow
treasure_hunts.summary: Trace a river flume down rapids and across fallen shipping containers to retrieve the lost vault key.
solution_steps: Locate the hillside cave along the river gorge and read the stash note.
Follow the river current and ziplines downstream toward the falls.
Locate the key caught in the stranded debris by the water's edge.
Unlock the sealed drainage container stash on the bank.

treasure_hunts.name: The Best Laid Plans
treasure_hunts.summary: Use grapple chain points and precision platforming across damaged rail bridge wreckage to access a suspended train car.
solution_steps: Read the note at the base of the collapsed railway trestle bridge.
Grapple upward through the broken bridge trusses.
Swing and leap across dangling railcars and support beams.
Reach the final cargo car perched on the bridge edge to collect the prepper stash.
